final: SELECT o.orderflow as status, AVG(oe.fillcount) as avg_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) as num_executions, CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orderexecutions WHERE ordersmark IN (SELECT recordvault FROM orders)) as fraction_of_all_executions FROM orders o INNER JOIN orderexecutions oe ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderflow    -- Returns status, avg filled quantity per execution, execution count, and exact fraction of all matched executions for each order status
